name: RT Slack Channel Notifications for WooCommerce
author: raintech357

sections.description:
Stay on top of your store’s activity with Slack Channel Notifications for WooCommerce. This plugin sends instant updates to your preferred Slack channel via Incoming Webhooks, ensuring you never miss an order or a stock event.

Features

  • New Order Alerts: Get notified the moment a customer places an order.
  • Status Change Notifications: Track order progress from pending to completed.
  • Stock Monitoring: Receive alerts for low stock and out-of-stock items.
  • Easy Setup: Simple configuration with Slack Incoming Webhooks.
  • Test Connection: Quick test button to verify your Slack integration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/slack-channel-notifications-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Integration > Slack Notifications.
  4. Enter your Slack Incoming Webhook URL and enable the notifications you wish to receive.

short_description: Get real-time notifications in Slack for WooCommerce events like new orders, status changes, and stock alerts.
